subject: Instats announces on-demand Structured Course in lavaan

messages.author: 2e1f893ffaa5b340
messages.subject: Instats announces on-demand Structured Course in lavaan
parts:
Hi everyone
The Institute for Statistical and Data Science (Instats) is announcing a new on-demand Structured Course in lavaan, consisting of four 2-day seminars. The link to the Course content is here:

https://instats.com/structuredcourse/from-beginning-to-advanced-sem-in-r-usin-7086

The seminars take users through a progression of Path Analysis, CFA/SEM, Longitudinal SEM, and finally Multilevel SEM. Along the way different methods for bootstrapping, Bayesian analysis, and moderated mediation are discussed in different modeling contexts. Special lavaan features are explored along with a variety of cool packages including semTools for latent variable interactions and other fun techniques.

Each seminar can be taken on its own, but by signing up for the Structured Course you can save 10%. As always, Instats offers discounts for PhD students and offers free weekly Office Hours where you can get personalized help with your data analytic challenges. Instats also offers consulting and custom programs if you think something more bespoke might be right for you and your research group.

Hope to see you at an Instats seminar soon, and happy modeling!

Mike

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
